claim: An autonomous agent can discover multiple high-quality solutions that outperform top leaderboard submissions under the same local evaluator, with stable optimization indicated by median runtimes below 2031 µs.
falsifier: One could apply the same agent to a different kernel engineering benchmark and measure whether it discovers multiple solutions with median runtime below a threshold.

conditions: the evaluator is local and same for all
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the kernel engineering task, the specific agent, and the comparison protocol described; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Agent to kernel engineering–discovery of multiple solutions principle
